title: Passions
subtitle: Art, music and where I come from

pages.title: Ioana-Teodora Gomoi
body: I am an AI researcher and a digital artist. I started with art and moved into machine learning because I wanted to build things that move, sound and look good.
I like problems where the maths has to work on something physical, such as a drone, a projector or a group of people.

pages.title: Painting and drawing
body: I paint, draw digitally and sketch, as well as work with interactive visual tools and photography. I have competed in digital art, and drawing is still the way I work out ideas before I write code.
I also make interactive visual work with TouchDesigner, p5.js, Three.js and shaders.
This is why I care about how figures and interfaces look in my research.

pages.title: Music
body: Music is important to me. I think about rhythm and melody in a similar way to loops and patterns in code.
The inside of my mind has a place that plays music when you walk close to it.
